title: Movie Gen: SWOT Analysis of Meta's Generative AI Foundation Model for Transforming Media Generation, Advertising, and Entertainment Industries

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation through a SWOT analysis framework, discussing the theoretical risk of generative AI producing culturally skewed or unrealistic portrayals based on biases inherited from its training data.
Conceptual evaluation as part of a SWOT analysis, identifying the threat of the model amplifying societal prejudices if its training data predominantly features certain demographics.
